technicalLines: The NHD-000-RACK4 does not come with encoder/decoder/controller device mounting brackets. These are required to mount encoders/decoders/controller into the NHD-000-RACK4. Device mounting brackets are included with the device, in the box.
The NHD-000-RACK4 includes 7 blanking plates. Additional NHD-000-RACK4 blanking plates are also available separately : (NHD-RACK4-BLK)
6U height and shallow depth allows for high component density in an AV or IT equipment rack
12 slots suitable for mounting a combination of 100, 400 Series, 500 Series, 600 Series & NetworkHD Controller devices
NetworkHD encoders or decoders can be mounted with connections front or rear facing to suit alternative cable management designs
The included removable rear cable management lacing bar helps route cabling at the correct point to optimize thermal efficiency
The included removable front-facing handles greatly improves maneuverability and convenience
Provides optimal thermal dissipation in a passively or actively cooled rack design to maintain premium device performance and MTBF
Enables systems to be pre-built into the rack kit prior to arriving on site to improve speed and efficiency of installation
Sturdy all-steel design creates a solid structure for supporting NetworkHD components
The NHD-000-RACK4 includes 7 blanking plates. Additional NHD-000-RACK4 blanking plates are also available separately: ( NHD-RACK4-BLK)
12 slots suitable for mounting a combination of 100 Series, 250 Decoder, 400 Series, 500 Series, 600 Series & NetworkHD Controller devices
